changelog_text:
**Updating:** back up `settings.json` and `Generated/` from your existing `purr2d2/` folder, delete that old mod folder, extract the new `purr2d2/` folder, then restore your saved settings and generated content. Restart KSA after updating.

## What's Changed
* fix(slicing): support native fallback mass by @alex-sherwin in https://github.com/meow-sci/purr2d2/pull/2


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/meow-sci/purr2d2/compare/v1.30.0...v1.32.0
